verdict.rationale: Airbyte offers a Connection Timeline showing sync history and events, and a dbt Cloud integration that chains transformations after syncs, giving some traceability of pipeline steps, but there is no documented lineage graph or catalog feature showing which sources/transformations produced each downstream table. missing for 10: dedicated lineage visualization/graph, column-level lineage, integration with lineage tools (e.g., OpenLineage), cross-system source-to-table mapping.
